resources.string: This app is a logbook. It does not give medical or training advice, and nothing in it replaces a doctor, dietitian or qualified coach. If you have a health condition or an injury, check with a professional.
Statistics describe what you logged; they are not medical or training advice.
The score and the advice compare your routine with general guidelines; they are not medical or training advice.
These goals are estimates from a general formula, not medical or nutritional advice. If you have a health condition, ask a doctor or dietitian.
